description: One airport in one call, by IATA or ICAO code: name, location and runways; live FAA status for US airports (ground stops, ground delay programs, arrival and departure delays, closures); the latest METAR and the TAF forecast, decoded (wind, gusts, visibility, clouds, weather, flight category VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR per period); and flags such as ground-stop or ifr. Data: aviationweather.gov (NOAA) and FAA NAS status. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
